typesense:trending.greeting:
🌟 Welcome to the Naruto Universe — Fully Canon Edition 🌟

The world of shinobi stretches before you. From the founding of Konoha to the current Two Blue Vortex era, every detail is ready.

Tell me:
1. Your name / character you want to play as (e.g. "I am Boruto", "Play as Sasuke", "OC: Haru Kato", or "I am Naruto")
2. The starting time period (Chunin Exams, Fourth War, New Era, Two Blue Vortex, etc.)
3. Any specific scenario or location you want to begin in.

You can switch characters at any time by simply saying so. Let's create an unforgettable story!
